youtube.title: Rent Receipt in Nigeria: The 7 Lines That Win Every Rent Dispute (Deep-Dive 3)
youtube.description:
"Show me your receipts" ends more rent disputes than any lawyer's speech. This Deep-Dive explains what a rent receipt is (and is not), who may issue one, the seven lines that make it bulletproof, the five quiet traps that swallow proof, the three myths that cost tenants money, how digital proof really works, what the Lagos Tenancy Law 2011 requires, and the exact steps to take if years of your rent sit unreceipted.

Build a proper rent receipt on your phone in under two minutes — figures to words, period spelled out, balance line for part payments:
https://docoga.com.ng

DocOga — every document a Nigerian needs. Free to start, no signup.

General information, not legal advice. Rules vary by state and by your agreement. The Lagos Tenancy Law 2011 (section 5) is cited for Lagos; other states have their own laws.
